rows.signal: formula predicate returns true for any element with a prover-supplied proof root
rows.why: the predicate proves self-consistency, never membership; the sound sibling (root bound to an on-chain value) rejects the same proof

controls.positive: real merkle-tree proof -> true (engine not broken)
controls.canary: arbitrary elements not in any tree

rows.signal: second 'good' unit with the same spend proof under a different address, no conflict detected
rows.why: the uniqueness key is the unit's own author, not the output owner the proof commits to; the check is the only network-wide protection and is keyed out of reach

controls.negative: same proof + same address -> cleanly rejected (the check works within an address)
controls.positive: same proof + different address -> silently accepted and saved 'good'
controls.canary: identical bearer proof under two addresses in the spend_proofs table
controls.replay: two independent runs + direct DB verification

rows.signal: settlement fee = round(base * (exp(tps) - 1)) with elapsed collapsing to 1
rows.why: each unit settles after its own MCI is balled, so the window count is 1 on the real path; the count>=30 state was synthesized (honest unit given the attacker's equal timestamps)

controls.negative: real 20-unit burst: fees 0-190 base, no negative balances
controls.positive: synthesized lag state reproduces the huge fee (proves the formula, not the reachability)

rows.signal: uncaught-throw sites in async completion callbacks (4 sites)
rows.why: every triggering state is unreachable: temp-bad resolution is atomic with ball creation; the address-binding check precedes the 'another address' throw; flow ordering preempts the spend-proof throw

controls.positive: seeded unreachable state -> crash (proves the mechanism, not the reachability)
controls.replay: fresh refuter independently reached the same verdict

rows.signal: unary-plus idiom on a TEXT column, engine-specific coercion suspected
rows.why: unary plus coerces only pure-integer strings; every engine matches only the intended value; the backend is marked unsupported

controls.negative: the exact predicate returns only 'good' on sqlite/MariaDB/MySQL5.7/MySQL8

rows.signal: upgrade-gated rules without the network-height disjunct (3 validation sites + 10 eval-side gates)
rows.why: old-DAG-attached units cannot stabilize (witnessed level is ancestry-derived; best-parent sorts by it; the MC walks from the tip), so the gated code never executes; every evaluation path runs at a current position

controls.negative: evaluation mci = current tip for triggers/getters/dry-runs
controls.positive: bare-mci gates diverge when the position is set low (mechanism, not reachability)

rows.signal: fee trusts the claimed temp-data length
rows.why: validation reconciles the claimed length against the actual length

rows.signal: canonicalization fixes in recent commits (-0, array descent, helper replacement)
rows.why: every hashing serializer is total and deterministic; no divergence path found

controls.negative: all serializers normalize -0 and sort keys
